description: State Ministry of Gem and Jewellery related Industries - Correction Notice to the Ex. Gaz. No. 2165/1 of 02.03.2020 (Only S)
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Industries under the National Gem and Jewellery Authority Act, specifically correcting typographical errors in previously published regulations. This falls under "Legal/Regulatory Gazettes" as it deals with regulatory frameworks, statutory instruments, and legal amendments to existing regulations.
